Acceptable Overkill is a unique laser gun in Fallout 76, introduced in the Nuclear Winter update. It was originally available as a reward for completing the weekly challenge of "Kill different kinds of critters" in Survival mode from July 9–15, 2019, and September 17–24, 2019. It was reworked with The Slasher update and added to the loot pool for the uninvited Pint-Sized Phantom appearing after the Mischief Night event in 2026.

Anti-tank mines are explosive devices found in Fallout Tactics. Anti-tank mines are generally much larger mines, intended to incapacitate or outright destroy both armored and unarmored vehicles. Much of the damage of an anti-tank mine is done from blast of the more powerful explosives. While anti-tank mines are primarily deployed to combat a vehicle threat, if triggered by personnel, can be very effective on large groups.

Armor and clothing are wearable items which increase chances of survival or add special attributes. There are many types of armor and clothing ranging from Vault jumpsuits to power armor, with power armor being the most powerful, but not necessarily the most useful, as it comes with some disadvantages such as decreased mobility and requires fusion cores to operate in some games.

Ballistic weave is an armor mod in Fallout 4 that allows for adding improved defensive stats to certain clothing items, including outfits, underarmor, and a small number of hats. Once learned, one will be able to upgrade any applicable clothing item at an armor workbench. Tinker Tom also sells some outfits with ballistic weave upgrades already applied.

Big Beard is a gun-for-hire residing in the Atomic Wrangler Casino in Freeside .
The Beretta 9mm is a weapon that was to appear in Fallout Extreme, a canceled game.
Beth's Weapon Shop is a weapons store owned by Beth in 2161. It is located in the Hub Downtown area next to the Friendly Lending Company, Mrs. Stapleton's library and Mitch's All-n-One Store.
The beta wave tuner is a weapon mod for the Gatling laser, the Institute laser, the laser gun and the plasma gun . It does not require any perks to craft.
Big Sister is a unique variant of the pipe rifle that is added to Fallout Shelter with the 1.4 update.
Betty Buttercup is a junk item in the Fallout 4 Creation Club content "Horse Power Armor."
Berkeley Springs Station is a train station in the town of Berkeley Springs, situated in the Mire region of Appalachia.
Best of Three is a quest "Tesla Cannon." The quest was later integrated into Fallout 4 for free as part of its next-gen update.
The Big Frigger is a weapon in the Fallout: The Board Game expansion Fallout: New California.
Blast Off pajamas are pre-War children's all in one clothing found in Fallout 3. The matching Blast Off helmet can be found in the game files but is not actually used in-game.
The biodiesel refinery is a building in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281. It is found in the northwestern part of Nellis Air Force Base, next to some yellow train carts and a small tower.
The bio grenade is a weapon that was to appear in Van Buren, the canceled Fallout 3 by Black Isle Studios. It also appears in the Van Buren tech demo game files.
Blade is the last of the four unique marked men encountered at the Divide in 2281.
Blade Runner is a film starring Harrison Ford, some scenes of which were set to appear in the canceled Fallout film.
The clean black suit and dirty black suit are pieces of clothing in Fallout 4. It takes up every free armor slot except for the head.
Black Ops armor is a unique legendary set of armor in Fallout 4.
Blanks was a professional fighter who lived before the Great War. He was involved in a controversy with a fellow fighter Kelley, which was reviewed by Nora in her legal capacities.
The bleeding bear trap is a weapon in the Fallout 4 add-on Far Harbor.
The bladed ball is a weapon mod for the paddle ball in the Fallout 4 add-on Nuka-World.
The bladed bull barrel is a weapon mod for the .44 pistol introduced in the Nuka-World add-on for Fallout 4.
